Storkow (Mark) ( German pronunciation: [ˈʃtɔʁkoː] ⓘ ) is a town in Oder-Spree district, in Brandenburg , Germany . The town was the part of Brandenberg Province of Prussia , from 1815 - 1947, then it was the part of the State of Brandenburg from 1947 to 1952, Bezirk Frankfurt of East Germany from 1952 to 1990 and it again became a part of the State of Brandenburg since 1990.
